title: Kayak Vacation Packages Scraper
description: Find Kayak flight-and-hotel packages with destination, fare, lodging details, provider, and booking link. Batch origin-destination pairs and choose future travel dates.

batch.title: Package destinations
batch.description: Package destinations and origin airports to search together.
batch.valueDescription: Destination used to run this search.

schema.description: KAYAK destination code for the vacation-package search.
Origin airport code for the route or destination search.
Outbound travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Return travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format after departure.
Number of adult travelers included in the search.
Ages of children included in the stay, when applicable.
Whether quoted prices are shown as totals or per-night or per-person values. Accepted values: perperson, total.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a.

relativeDateDefaults.description: When omitted, departure is set to 30 days from today.
When omitted, return is set to four days after departure.

results.localizedDescription: Flight and hotel bundle near the Strip

storeCopy.seoTitle: Kayak Vacation Packages | Flight & Hotel Deals
storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Kayak vacation packages by origin, destination, and dates. Export flight details, hotel information, provider names, prices, and booking links.
storeCopy.intro: Search Kayak for flight-and-hotel packages with trip summaries, flight legs, lodging details, providers, prices, and booking links. Batch route pairs for future dates.
useCases: Travel planners can compare bundled flight and hotel offers.
Travel agencies can shortlist packages for several airport pairs.
Fare analysts can track bundle prices alongside standalone trips.
howToUse: Add a destination and origin airport to each entry in `package_searches`.
Set departure and return dates or use the relative date defaults.
Choose passenger count, duration, price mode, and sorting options.

faqs.question: Is the displayed package price per person or for the full group?
faqs.answer: That depends on `price_mode`. Choose `perperson` or `total` to request the corresponding KAYAK price display.
